question: Does a lesson written into Bossman's EXISTING memory (POST /api/memory/lessons -> facts) and recalled automatically at TASK_START change a LOCAL model's answers on NEW held-out tasks of the lesson's class, without regressing unrelated tasks? Memory record != weight training != proven transfer.
what_is_measured: Transfer of a CONVENTION the model cannot derive from the task text (SwapMe desk margin 3 % and desk-favour rounding direction). Held-out prompts name the desk rule but never state it. This measures whether recall injects the lesson and whether the model applies it; it does NOT measure reasoning improvement and NEVER weight training.
path: POST /api/tasks (run_now, explicit agent) -> Engine -> TASK_START recall -> model via OpenAI-compat provider -> GET /api/tasks/{id}

backend.exercise_keys_dir: temp, outside data dir and repo

model.why_this_model: local Bossman agent model (pult AGENT mode qwen3-coder); fast A3B MoE so 2 x 3 x 38 runs fit; Gemma 4 31B is loaded by another session and is not disturbed

sampling.how: sampling_proxy.py injects temperature/seed (Bossman's engine sends none; the Modelfile default is 0.7). Messages/tools/response pass through unchanged.

model.unload_after: keep_alive 0 for this model only, if it was not loaded before the run

agent.name: Bossman lesson-transfer probe (local)
agent.system_prompt: Ты — Bossman, деловой ассистент. Считай аккуратно, покажи короткий расчёт и дай ответ в требуемом формате.

payload.title: SwapMe: котировка стола — наценка 3 %, округление в пользу стола
payload.body:
Правило обменного стола SwapMe (код: bossman_shared/exchange_assistant/quote.py, build_quote; наценка по умолчанию DEFAULT_MARGIN = 0.03). Считать только в Decimal, никогда во float.
1) Клиент ПОКУПАЕТ валюту X за CZK (называет, сколько X хочет получить): платит = сумма × mid (CZK за 1 X) × 1.03, округление ВВЕРХ (ROUND_UP) до 0.01 CZK.
2) Клиент ПРОДАЁТ валюту X за CZK (называет, сколько X отдаёт): получает = сумма × mid × 0.97, округление ВНИЗ (ROUND_DOWN) до 0.01 CZK.
Округление всегда в пользу стола, а не «половина вверх».
Пример: покупка 1000 USDT при mid 25 → 1000 × 25 × 1.03 = 25750.00 CZK; продажа 1000 USDT при mid 25 → 24250.00 CZK.
Пример округления: покупка 360 EUR при mid 24.417 → 8790.12 × 1.03 = 9053.8236 → 9053.83 CZK (вверх); продажа 1310 USD при mid 23.581 → 30891.11 × 0.97 = 29964.3767 → 29964.37 CZK (вниз).
Не применять, если в задаче явно задана другая комиссия, наценка или правило округления: тогда действует правило задачи.
payload.author: claude
limitations: Только наценка по умолчанию 3 %: если менеджер задал свою ставку или включён строгий режим compute_quote_strict (COM-UP-1), коэффициенты 1.03/0.97 не действуют.
mid в задачах берётся из условия; настоящий стол берёт курсы ЧНБ/ЕЦБ/ручные с TTL, USDT через USDT/USD.
Проверено на синтетических котировках и упражнении swap_desk_quote_v1; на реальных сделках не проверялось.
Запись урока — не обучение весов модели; применение урока доказывается отдельным экспериментом.

exercise.use: AFTER phase: the model solves it through the task path; ITS answer goes to /verify (server runs the checker)

sets.heldout: 20 NEW SwapMe desk quotes (H01-H20), rule not stated; 12/20 also discriminate desk rounding vs half-up
sets.independent: 6 tasks the lesson was not written for (I01-I06): same rule, other framing, no 'SwapMe'/'стол', composites
sets.control: 12 tasks (C01-C12): 4 near-miss money tasks with an EXPLICIT different rule + 8 unrelated

phases: after (same backend data dir after restart, lesson in memory, recall on)

ground_truth.location: outside the repo and outside the temp data dir (session scratchpad keys/)
ground_truth.published: with results.json after the runs (post-hoc disclosure)

scorer.parse: take the value after the LAST 'ОТВЕТ:'; if absent, the last number in the answer (flagged format_fallback). Numbers: drop spaces/nbsp, ',' is a decimal point unless '.' also present (then ',' is a thousands separator). Correct iff Decimal(parsed) == Decimal(truth) exactly (money truth has 2 dp, so 18828.1425 != 18828.15). Text: casefold, strip punctuation, equal.
scorer.unit: task passes in a phase iff >= 2 of 3 repetitions are correct (majority)
scorer.infra_failure: a run whose task status != completed counts as incorrect and is reported

decision_rule.headroom_gate: baseline heldout passes >= 17/20 -> INCONCLUSIVE ('no headroom - transfer not demonstrable')
decision_rule.recall_gate: AFTER: the lesson's fact id appears in memory.recalled sources in >= 95 % of heldout runs, and in 0 baseline runs; otherwise FAIL (memory did not inject the lesson)
decision_rule.infra_gate: > 10 % of runs in either phase not completed -> INCONCLUSIVE
decision_rule.PASS: delta = heldout_after - heldout_baseline >= 8 tasks AND one-sided exact sign test on discordant heldout tasks p <= 0.01 AND control regressions == 0 (a control task majority-pass at baseline and majority-fail after)
decision_rule.FAIL: delta <= 3 OR control regressions >= 2 OR recall gate fails
decision_rule.independent_set: secondary, descriptive: 'generalises' only if independent_after - independent_baseline >= 3 of 6

deviations_policy: any deviation from this file is listed in README_RU.md with the reason; nothing is re-run selectively
pipeline_smoke_before_prereg: one non-experimental prompt ('2 + 3') through the same path, to check the plumbing only; it is not part of any set
